alpha_hypothesis.playbook_alignment: Targets state-surface maturation through a new rank-depth quality field instead of adjacent score-gap, repeat-lookback, sector, ret20, or ret60 retuning.

backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md canonical three fixed windows; core unchanged plus default-off state-surface paper overlay replay.

gate3.hard_rule: No filter or candidate gate changed; only queue_rank=3 paper notional changes.

history_check.exp-20260518-021: Rejected rank-2 ret5 leadership; this does not use ret5 or shift to rank 2.
history_check.exp-20260518-024: Rejected low-volume rank-1 dominance; this does not use volume.
history_check.exp-20260519-002: Accepted same-ticker repeat scalar; this experiment does not change repeat lookback or scalar.
history_check.exp-20260519-003: Accepted rank-1 score-isolation; this experiment freezes it and tests a different rank-depth field.

hypothesis: When a rotation state-surface queue's third-ranked candidate is still close to its own 60-day high, queue depth is healthier and rank 3 deserves a bounded default-off paper-notional support scalar.
interpretation: Rank-3 near-high support improved the default-off state-surface paper overlay in all three windows, with no drawdown worsening and lower single-ticker positive concentration.

llm_metrics.why_not_llm: LLM soft-ranking data remains sparse/PIT-limited; this deterministic rank-depth field is replayable from OHLCV-derived near-high metadata.

next_evidence_needed: Promote only as shared default-off paper metadata; keep forward tail/concentration monitoring before any live adapter work.

parameters.profile_priority: after accepted rank-notional profiles and before pending paper entry; applies only to queue_rank=3

protocol_answers.1_alpha_hypothesis: capital allocation: queue_rank=3 candidates close to 60-day highs indicate healthier queue depth and deserve bounded paper-notional support.
protocol_answers.2_history_check: Prior accepted work covered score-expansion, repeat, and rank1 isolation; rejected work covered ret5 and volume. No logged experiment used rank3 near-high support.
protocol_answers.4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; positive aggregate EV/PnL, all three windows EV-positive, zero EV-regressed windows, adjusted trades >=5 across all 3 windows, max DD drift <=0.5pp, single-ticker positive share <=50%.
